lines.beaver_en: Hello, I'm Minjun Kim, the new hire.
lines.learner: 반가워요. 저는 이 부서 교육 담당 박서연 대리예요.
lines.en: Nice to meet you. I'm Seoyeon Park, assistant manager in charge of training.
lines.roman: bangawoyo. jeoneun i buseo gyoyuk damdang baksseoyeon daeriyeyo.

lines.beaver: 대리님, 우리 부서는 어떤 일을 하나요?
lines.beaver_roman: daerinim, uri buseoneun eotteon ireul hanayo?
lines.learner: 본부의 해외 판매를 맡아요. 책임이 꽤 커요.
lines.en: We handle overseas sales for headquarters. It's a big responsibility.
lines.roman: bonbuui haeoe panmaereul matayo. chaegimi kkwae keoyo.

lines.beaver_en: What about the workload? Is it very busy?
lines.en: We're short-handed. We even take turns working late.

lines.beaver: 그럼 곧바로 사람을 더 뽑지 않나요?
lines.beaver_en: Then won't they hire more people right away?
lines.beaver_roman: geureom gotbaro sarameul deo ppopjji annayo?
lines.learner: 두 명이 그만둬서 지금 뽑고 있어요.
lines.en: Two people quit, so we're hiring now.
lines.roman: du myeongi geumandwoseo jigeum ppopkko isseoyo.

lines.learner: 네, 임금이 높다는 것은 이 표로 알 수 있어요.
lines.en: Yes, you can tell from this chart that wages are high.
lines.roman: ne, imgeumi nopttaneun geoseun i pyoro al ssu isseoyo.

lines.beaver: 와, 정말 그렇네요. 상사분들은 어떤 분들이에요?
lines.beaver_en: Wow, it's true. What are the bosses like?
lines.beaver_roman: wa, jeongmal geureonneyo. sangsabundeureun eotteon bundeurieyo?
lines.learner: 책임자인 최 부장님은 업적이 많은 분이에요.
lines.en: Our head, Manager Choi, has many achievements.
lines.roman: chaegimjain choe bujangnimeun eopjjeogi maneun bunieyo.

lines.learner: 벽에 걸린 상장을 보면 알 수 있어요.
lines.en: You can tell from the awards hanging on the wall.
lines.roman: byeoge geollin sangjangeul bomyeon al ssu isseoyo.

lines.beaver: 직장 생활에 대해 더 말씀해 주시겠어요?
lines.beaver_en: Could you tell me more about work life?
lines.beaver_roman: jikjjang saenghware daehae deo malsseumhae jusigesseoyo?
lines.learner: 맞벌이 직원이 많아서 서로 일을 도와줘요.
lines.en: Many staff are dual-income, so we help each other.
lines.roman: matbeori jigwoni manaseo seoro ireul dowajwoyo.

lines.beaver: 분위기가 좋네요. 저는 무엇부터 하면 될까요?
lines.beaver_en: Nice atmosphere. What should I start with?
lines.beaver_roman: bunwigiga jonneyo. jeoneun mueotbuteo hamyeon doelkkayo?
lines.learner: 먼저 근무 시간 관리를 맡아 주세요.
lines.en: First, please take charge of managing work hours.
lines.roman: meonjeo geunmu sigan gwallireul mata juseyo.

lines.beaver_en: Okay, I'll work hard. Thank you!
lines.en: Ask me anytime if you don't know something.
